reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory predicate that every month-wide action already calls, rather than adding filters in each action.

duplication.why: The rule lives once in the predicate and the duplicated hidden filter in the average SQL is removed, but goal_def has to be added to three separate category queries (getBudgetData plus both branches of getMonthBudgetCategories) that the tree already duplicated.

placement.why: The rule change sits in month-action-categories.ts, the module the tree designates as the shared category policy for month-wide actions.

scope.why: Only the predicate, its type and the queries feeding it are touched.

maintainability.why: Clear single predicate, though its `action` parameter is now unused and 'has a saved template' is an inline `goal_def === '[]'` string comparison rather than a named check.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the average actions all still go through shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory/getMonthBudgetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: Nothing duplicated; the SQL-side hidden filter was removed in favour of the predicate.

one_place.where: shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/month-action-categories.ts decides hidden, group-hidden and saved-template exclusion for all month-wide actions.
